stateOwnerDisposition: The same single-writer DurableInferenceControl journal owns legacy records and native hosted request identity, local in-flight slot reservations, dispatch bindings and observations.
terminalObserverDisposition: The actual Agent-fenced App Server client supplies matching turn observations through a trusted in-process port. Missing tokens remain null; uncertain execution holds its local slot. This is not provider billing or signed remote-worker authority.

operations.sourceSemantics: Pins explicit local slot capacity and exact request identity before provider contact.
Syncs exact thread/provider/context dispatch intent before the actual turn/start RPC; a duplicate cannot issue a new turn.
Persists interrupt intent without releasing an in-flight slot; acknowledgement is not terminality.

Persists actual matching terminal and optional observed u64 usage; terminality releases a local slot, unknown execution remains held. Late usage can refine an observation without changing its terminal outcome.

repositoryControlledGaps: Connect economically meaningful quota and hardware-capacity authorities; the shipped native policy reserves only local in-flight run slots.
Implement authenticated recovery of actual provider terminal/usage observations after process loss; reopening a dispatched run conservatively holds capacity and never replays it.
Add bounded archival/retention under the same journal owner; the current 64 MiB journal rejects further appends without truncating acknowledged history.
externalEvidenceGates: real provider deployment and crash/cancellation acceptance
